mathematical_change: For spectral split A=B+C with B the selected rank-three protected core and C nonzero orthogonal residual, (U^T X, X^T C X) has a joint R4 density because the map is a submersion off ker C.
For S=X^T B X and V=X^T C X, ||p_(S+V)||_infinity <= E ||p_(S|V)||_infinity; the residual-level supremum in the current owner route is unnecessary.
Combining the rank-three coarea bound gives ||p_Q||_infinity <= K int p_V(v)^(1/3)||G(.,v)||_infinity^(2/3)dv, where G is the joint density of (U^T X,V).
For every probability law mu, its interval-density seminorm equals sup_(eta,t)(P_eta*mu)(t)=(1/pi)sup_(Im z>0) Im m_mu(z); Poisson heights are monotone as eta downarrow0.
The sharp QFORM constant equals the sharp constant on Cauchy-output-regularized affine targets, uniformly in eta; dyadic eta suffice.
